target_customer: Companies with sales and customer service teams that train staff
problem: Employees forget most of what they learn in training within days. Hickory predicts when a rep will forget material and schedules tailored review exercises.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with tiered plans (Essentials, Premium, Enterprise) and 30-day trials
product_category: Learning management system with spaced repetition

founders.name: Brian Tobal
founders.background_notes: YC page and the YC launch post (2015-07-31) give no background or education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Spaced repetition scheduling that models forgetting per employee, plus content import and reporting. Standard SaaS engineering with an algorithmic component.

defensibility.rationale: Training content and performance history could create mild lock-in, but spaced repetition is a known technique and easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying or buying it.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites a claim that about 70 percent of training is forgotten within five days, and the product targeted sales and service teams, but no customer or spend figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses hickorytraining.com rather than hickory.com, per the YC page

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline 'Make every employee an expert' on the current site

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. The name is a common word shared with many unrelated companies such as Hickory Farms, which makes search hard.

outcome_analysis: Hickory launched from YC S15 in July 2015 with a retention-focused training product and, per CB Insights, raised a seed round of 1.3 million dollars in 2017. The YC directory lists it as inactive, yet its website is live with paid plans and an iOS app carries a 2022 copyright, so its real status is unclear and no shutdown cause was found. The cause of any failure is not public and no failure factors are asserted.
notes: YC marks it Inactive but the site hickorytraining.com is live (modern LMS, spaced repetition, three paid tiers) and an App Store listing by Hickory Software Labs carries a 2022 copyright; Crunchbase lists it under the name Versed, relation unverified. CB Insights reports $3.52M over four rounds but only the 2017 seed is dated, so rounds are missing and the gap is unresolved. The round rests on a single database. CB Insights also lists Arnaud Meunier as co-founder, but no YC or company source says so, so he is not recorded. No dated competitor source was found near the batch; spaced repetition rivals such as Qstream appear only in undated 2025 and 2026 pages, so the list is left empty.
